gemma31b.sentence: A familiar name moves the product's representation in the direction that a better listed warranty and failure rate move it, and pushing a product with an invented name in that direction raises the model's preference for it. At the average size of the name's change, the push changed the model's preference for the product without changing its recommendation; at 2 times that size it changed the recommendation as well. The same push changes the recommendation less when every product lists its warranty, failure rate and time on the market.

gemma4-26b.sentence_q9: When the answer cannot read the names in layers 16 to 20, the model recommends the better product more (1.2 points), beside 3.1 points through the product's later tokens. When it cannot read them in any layer, the better product gains 2.0 points, 19 per cent of the gap.
gemma4-26b.sentence_q10: A more cautious model favors familiar names more. At the size chosen on the product-free questions, the push changed how much the model's preference favored familiar names, without changing how often it recommends them.
gemma4-26b.sentence_q7: Removing the name direction from the weights did not lower the share of other products (-1.3 points with the names shown) or general accuracy; a random direction removed the same way raised that share by 21.7 points and lowered accuracy by 9.6 points, so the random edit cannot serve as a control for the name.
